purpose: Offline policy regression only; examples and expected answers are public. Not an Agent blind test, scientific novelty proof, token improvement or training authorization.

cases.context: Public papers identify costly sensor calibration; a strong subsequent paper may already remove this need.
cases.preferred_action: Check nearest full-text method and whether unmet deployment capability remains.

cases.context: Two studies disagree about tactile benefit but use different tasks and sensor budgets.
cases.preferred_action: Align protocol and formulate a variable with distinct competing predictions.

cases.context: A model fails only for unseen devices, but participants also change by device.
cases.preferred_action: Inspect independent groups and confounding before proposing domain generalization.

cases.context: A widely used benchmark uses split windows from the same acquisition sequence.
cases.preferred_action: Audit original group IDs and measurement truth; propose a valid benchmark contract.

cases.context: An agent suggests adding a standard contrastive module to tactile prediction.
cases.preferred_action: Identify required new capability and distinguish it from existing domain equivalents.

cases.context: A reliable existing DEV result contradicts a published claim; holdout untouched.
cases.preferred_action: Separate bug/protocol causes, seek competing explanation, and label ex-post hypothesis.

cases.context: An offline oracle uses future labels to select scarce sensing channels.
cases.preferred_action: Reject deployable improvement claim; check legitimate predecision information.

cases.context: Official stiffness tags are proxy labels; no independent modulus truth.
cases.preferred_action: Do not claim physical hardness; narrow to measurable proxies or propose true measurement.

cases.context: An easy benchmark baseline is already near saturation; novel system is expensive.
cases.preferred_action: Compare important real-world constraint and a minimal discriminating test before investment.

cases.context: A promising post-hoc DEV subgroup improves but was selected on the same evaluation data.
cases.preferred_action: Keep exploratory with selection history; reserve independent evidence without reading sealed.

cases.context: A new dataset could align incompatible tactile task protocols but licenses are unknown.
cases.preferred_action: Read official metadata only; stop at planning before unapproved download or fitting.

cases.context: An AI agent proposes ViT + Mamba + MoE because all three are popular, without a documented failure mechanism or nearest whole-system comparator.
cases.preferred_action: Identify specific missing capability and functional complementary roles, inspect prior whole-combination papers, then propose a falsifiable coupling prediction; popularity and stacking alone are not novelty.

cases.context: A sensor scheduling proposal masks full tactile signals offline but uses future contact labels to decide which channels to observe, then claims online power savings.
cases.preferred_action: Reject future-label oracle as causal online policy; verify predecision information and treat offline masking as information-budget simulation, not measured device energy.

cases.context: Modules A and B together improve metric but with more parameters and compute; neither A only nor B only nor naive A+B has been compared, yet the agent claims synergistic causal novelty.
cases.preferred_action: Plan task-matched ablations and a same-component naive-composition comparator; report budget and uncertainty and treat interaction delta as metric-scale descriptive evidence only.
